verses.text: People of Israel, listen to the message of the LORD. The LORD has brought charges against you who live in the land: "There is no faithfulness, no kindness, and no knowledge of God in the land.
There is only cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and adultery. People break all the rules, and one killing follows another.
So the land dries up, and everyone who lives in it wastes away. The wild animals, the birds of the sky, and even the fish in the sea are dying.
"But let no one bring a charge, and let no one accuse anyone else, because my complaint is against you, priests.
You stumble by day, and the prophets stumble with you by night. So I will destroy your mother, Israel.

My people are destroyed because they do not know me. Because you priests have refused to know me, I refuse to let you be my priests. Because you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
The more priests there were, the more they sinned against me. So I will turn their glory into shame.
They feed on the sins of my people. They want the people to keep on sinning.
It will be the same for the people and for the priests. I will punish them for their ways and pay them back for what they have done.
They will eat, but never have enough. They will be unfaithful, but they will not have more children, because they have turned away from the LORD.
Unfaithfulness, old wine, and new wine take away my people's good sense.
My people ask a wooden idol for advice and expect a stick of wood to answer them. A spirit of unfaithfulness has led them astray. They have been unfaithful to their God.

They offer sacrifices on the mountaintops and burn incense on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth trees, where the shade is pleasant. That is why your daughters become prostitutes and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.

I will not punish your daughters when they become prostitutes, or your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, because the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with temple prostitutes. A people without understanding will be ruined.
"Israel, even though you are unfaithful, do not let Judah become guilty too. Do not go to Gilgal or up to Beth Aven, and do not swear, 'As surely as the LORD lives.'
The people of Israel are as stubborn as a stubborn young cow. So how can the LORD feed them like lambs in an open pasture?
Ephraim has joined himself to idols. Leave him alone!
When their drinking is over, they go on being unfaithful. Their rulers dearly love shameful ways.
A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
